Hymn 266: The Time Is Far Spent
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: E-flat Major

This is hymn number 266 titled "The Time Is Far Spent" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in E-flat Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by George Careless and the lyrics were written by Eliza R. Snow.
